_comment: Configuration for the installer's optional self-repair.
Self-repair only runs if BOTH of these are true:
- the person running setup pasted an Anthropic key at the prompt, and
- she then answered yes to 'use it to fix problems automatically?'
A key without consent does nothing. Declining costs her nothing except
the ability to self-repair; the installer works either way.
The caps below exist so a pathological failure loop cannot spend her API
budget or hang the install. max_total_heals is the number of diagnosis
calls across the WHOLE install; each step separately gets at most 3
The rate table is used only to put an approximate number in the install
report so Stephen can see what healing cost. It is an estimate baked in
at build time, not a bill, and it will drift as published prices change.
_model_note: Sonnet rather than Haiku because the input is gnarly, low-signal tool
output and a wrong diagnosis costs a wasted remediation plus a retry.
At roughly 2k input and 200 output tokens per call, twelve calls is
around eleven cents. Switch to claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 if that ever
